copy.lede: The shop that services the movements other businesses mail away. Clocks, watches and the small repair nobody else on the peninsula will touch, on a bench you can walk up to in Santa Clara.

concept.dir: Horological luxe-dark: an escapement-inspired hairline motif, seconds-ring progress indicators instead of scroll bars, macro movement photography, and a service-tier table. Motion: single sweeping seconds hand, reduced-motion aware.
interactive: Rotating seconds-hand motif as a section marker
Service tiers table with turnaround bands
Intake form asking for movement type and brand
Restoration gallery with hover detail cards
concept.refs: A manufacture service page for an independent bench.
